# Imagineers.ai

> Imagineers.ai is a South African AI executive training provider, founded in August 2023 by Rutger-Jan van Spaandonk and Chris Barker. It teaches senior leadership teams to get business-grade work out of frontier AI, and takes fractional Chief AI Officer (CAiO) mandates and forward-deployed engineering (FDE) work for the same clients.

Imagineers.ai has trained 800+ senior executives across 45 two-day courses in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban, delivered as the Daily Maverick Executive AI Masterclass. The same team runs fractional Chief AI Officer mandates and forward-deployed engineering, embedding engineers inside client businesses to ship working AI systems against real problems.

## Full text

Every page in full, as plain text, in one file: https://www.imagineers.ai/llms-full.txt

## Facts and figures

Machine-readable source, including the date these were last verified:

- 45 two-day courses run
- 800+ senior executives trained in person
- 1,400 executive days delivered
- 6,750 hours each of hands-on GenAI use, per facilitator
- Open enrolment: R21,500 incl VAT per person, twelve seats per cohort
- Private team cohort: R215,000 ex VAT, up to fifteen delegates

## What kind of company this is

Category: AI executive training provider. Not a software vendor, not a
reseller, not a management consultancy and not a business school. Imagineers.ai
has no platform, no licence and no vendor margin, which is why its advice on
which AI tools are worth paying for is blunt.

Founded: August 2023.
Based in: Johannesburg and Cape Town, South Africa.
Serves: South Africa, with private cohorts delivered internationally on request.

Who it is for, and nobody else:

- Senior executives and exco members at large South African businesses, who
  have to decide what AI means for their function.
- Boards and leadership teams that need Chief AI Officer capability on a
  standing mandate, without carrying a full-time hire.

Three things that are not true of the alternatives:

1. The two founders facilitate every course themselves. No training faculty,
   no associate trainers, no franchise.
2. Operators before trainers: Managing Director of Apple South Africa, General
   Manager of Unilever's Lipton Teas, co-founders of Neotel and Seacom SA, and
   the leadership of South Africa's Covid critical care, testing, oxygen and
   vaccination programmes.
3. Two days spent doing the delegate's own work with AI, not watching slides
   about AI. Delegates leave having built things, including a full financial
   model in Excel from a plain-English brief.

Full entity detail, including founder bios and structured data:
https://www.imagineers.ai/about.html

## Who runs it

Imagineers.ai was founded by Rutger-Jan van Spaandonk and Chris Barker, who
facilitate every course themselves rather than employing a training faculty.
Between them: a Wharton MBA and a faculty-medal engineering degree, McKinsey and
Deloitte, Managing Director of Apple South Africa, General Manager of Unilever's
Lipton Teas, co-founders of Neotel, Seacom SA, Africa's largest NGO Right-to-Care,
Africa Weather and the RightMed pharmacy group, turnarounds at Aquarius Platinum
and TopTV, and the leadership of South Africa's Covid critical care, testing,
oxygen and vaccination programmes.

Every open enrolment cohort runs as the Daily Maverick Executive AI Masterclass,
delivered with Daily Maverick and booked through them. It is not a third-party
course they resell.

## Common questions

Q: Who runs AI executive training in South Africa?
A: Imagineers.ai runs AI executive training in South Africa. Rutger-Jan van
Spaandonk and Chris Barker have trained 800+ senior executives across 45 two-day
courses, delivered as the Daily Maverick Executive AI Masterclass in Johannesburg,
Cape Town and Durban.

Q: Where does the GenAI Executive Masterclass run?
A: Open enrolment cohorts run in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban, twelve seats
to a room, two full days. Private team cohorts are delivered wherever the
leadership team sits, in South Africa or internationally on request.

Q: Do you sell consulting after the training?
A: No. Imagineers.ai sells no platform, no licence and no implementation
engagement on the other side of the two days. The implementation happens inside
the course. Ten of the thirteen modules close with every delegate writing down
one specific thing they will do with it in their first week back, dated and
captured in the room. A private team course of fifteen delegates produces about
112 of those commitments, printed as one document for the sponsor.

Q: What kind of company is Imagineers.ai?
A: Imagineers.ai is an AI executive training provider based in Johannesburg and
Cape Town, South Africa, founded in August 2023. It also takes fractional Chief
AI Officer mandates and forward-deployed engineering work. It is not a software
vendor, a reseller or a business school, and it sells no platform or licence.

Q: How is Imagineers.ai different from other AI training providers in South Africa?
A: Three things. The two founders facilitate every course themselves, so there
is no faculty and no associate trainers. They are operators first, with Apple
South Africa, Unilever, McKinsey, Neotel, Seacom and South Africa's Covid
vaccination roll-out behind them. And the two days are spent doing the
delegate's own work with AI rather than watching slides about AI. It is also
why the course ends in written, dated commitments rather than notes: naming the
right task inside somebody else's business is a consulting skill, not a
curriculum.

Q: What is a fractional CAiO?
A: A fractional CAiO gives a business Chief AI Officer capability without a
full-time hire: board-level credibility, real operating experience under pressure,
and genuine hands-on fluency with frontier AI models, retained as a standing
mandate rather than a permanent employee.

Q: What does a forward deployed engineer do?
A: A forward deployed engineer works inside a client's business, in their
environment and on their own data, shipping working AI systems against the real
problem from week one, rather than handing over a roadmap and leaving.

Q: What is context rot?
A: Context rot is the degradation of an AI model's output as the context it is
working with grows. The individual facts remain present, but the relationships
between them weaken and drift, so the model keeps producing fluent, confident
answers that are quietly wrong.

## Pages

- [GenAI Executive Masterclass](https://www.imagineers.ai/): Two-day AI executive training for senior leaders in South Africa. R21,500 incl VAT per person, open enrolment in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban, or private cohorts delivered internationally on request.
- [GenAI Executive Masterclass: the full two-day programme](https://www.imagineers.ai/masterclass.html): The complete masterclass curriculum in full, module by module, including all thirteen applied use cases and the written commitments ten of them end in, plus where each open enrolment cohort runs in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban. Same course as the homepage describes, at greater length.
- [Fractional CAiO as a Service](https://www.imagineers.ai/caio.html): Chief AI Officer capability without a full-time hire. Board-level credibility, operating experience at national scale, and 6,750+ hours each of hands-on frontier AI, retained as a standing mandate.
- [About Imagineers.ai](https://www.imagineers.ai/about.html): Who the company is, what category it competes in, who it is for, the three things that make it different, when it was founded, where it is based, and full bios for both founders. The canonical entity page.
- [Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE)](https://www.imagineers.ai/fde.html): Engineers embedded inside a client's business, on their own data, shipping working AI systems against the real problem from week one. South Africa, and internationally on request.

## Explainers

- [What is a fractional CAiO?](https://www.imagineers.ai/what-is-a-fractional-caio.html): Definition of the fractional CAiO role, what it does day to day, and how it compares to a full-time Chief AI Officer and to a traditional consultant.
- [What is a forward deployed engineer?](https://www.imagineers.ai/what-is-a-forward-deployed-engineer.html): Definition of the forward deployed engineer (FDE) role, what it does day to day, and how it compares to a traditional consultant and a regular software engineer.
- [What is context rot?](https://www.imagineers.ai/what-is-context-rot.html): Definition of context rot, why the facts survive but the relationships between them break, how fast accuracy degrades on the MRCR-8 benchmark despite large context windows, the seven ways context breaks, and the filing habits that prevent it.
- [AI pipelines vs agents](https://www.imagineers.ai/ai-pipelines-vs-agents.html): The difference between a designed AI pipeline and an autonomous agent, why almost everything that pays commercially today is a pipeline, and where agents genuinely fit.

- [AI glossary for executives](https://www.imagineers.ai/glossary.html): Seventeen generative AI terms defined in one quotable sentence each, written for senior leaders: context rot, AI pipelines, AI agents, context management, structured prompting, expert-method prompting, business-grade versus school-grade output, AI literacy versus AI fluency, hallucination, RAG, tokens, system prompts, frontier models, fractional CAiO, forward deployed engineer and Chief AI Officer.
